x: They were followed in by the T.V.H. star Alec Olney and another young rising luminary Walter Hesketh from Manchester A.C. Lancashire were clear in the team championship with a fifty points margin over Warwickshire.

Frank Sando, Walter Hesketh, Alan Parker and Fred Norris provided strong opposition to our leading pair. British hurdling produced good competitors in the high hurdles by European standards but Peter Hildreth and Frank Parker were still the proverbial half second behind their American counterparts.

What names there are to recall in that piece - Harry Hicks became a team mate in 1956, Gordon Pirie a friend from the same time and then Walter Hesketh who was a Fascist election candidate for the area I was responsible for in Manchester!
